_how_to: This file lists the real videos shown in Why Pi in Saudi?. The app reads it each time the section opens.
To publish a film: copy its files into /videos (and subtitles into /videos/subs), then fill in its "src" below.
An entry with an empty "src" is ignored, so its story card keeps showing 'Filming soon'.
kind must be honest: "filmed" = real people, "screen" = a recording of the app, "generated" = made with AI tools.
story links a film to its story card: friends, business, street, travellers, innovation.
Files: keep each MP4 under 20 MB (Cloudflare Pages allows 25 MB per file). src_sd is the small data-saver copy.
The five app tours are built into the app; you do not need to list them here.

Your own recording of a built-in app tour in another language: add { "id": "tour-why", "by_lang": { "ar": { "src": "/videos/tour-why.ar.mp4", "src_sd": "/videos/tour-why.ar-sd.mp4", "poster": "/videos/tour-why.ar.jpg" } } } — Arabic viewers then see it instead of the English one.
